# Dentist OS
> Dentist OS is a dental practice management operating system built by Beyond Pixells
> (product studio, India). Built for clinics, not marketplaces — patients stay yours.

## Core Capabilities
- WhatsApp-native patient communication: booking confirmations, 2-hour reminders,
  post-treatment care instructions, X-rays and estimates, 1-click review triggers
- Visual tooth-charting with treatment planning and digital estimates to WhatsApp
- Milestone fee collection: multi-sitting plans billed in phases with automatic UPI
  payment requests (30% advance / 40% prep / 30% cementation)
- Automated patient recall engine at 3, 6 and 12 months (scaling, crown checks, aligners)
- Dental lab workflow tracker with pre-appointment delivery alerts
- Multi-chair calendars + visiting specialist commission engine
- Branded clinic website, patient portal and owner command center
- India-native: UPI, GST invoices, DCI-aligned consent templates, DPDP-aligned data handling

## Pricing
- One-time setup + flat monthly: Solo Starter ₹2,499/mo (+₹15,000 setup),
  Pro Multi-Chair ₹4,999/mo (+₹25,000 setup), Chain custom.
- No per-patient fees. Prices ex-GST. Research-recommended tiers; founder confirmation pending.
